body: Commit 10a705d (+ CHANGELOG). Ported gpt2-alpine-c's own C GPT-2 inference engine verbatim into packages/common/gpt2_infer.c/.h (fully parameterized -- no changes needed for a smaller model). colab_train.py now trains a small from-scratch GPT2Config (not a fine-tune of the 497MB GPT-2-small, too big to commit/too slow for real-time inference) and, after training, exports to the C engine's binary format and pushes to origin/main via an SSH key at MyDrive/.ssh/id_ed25519 if present. Verified end to end locally: real exported tiny model loaded through the real C loader, finite forward-pass logits. 5 new tests, full suite green. Live bot-AI wiring explicitly NOT done, flagged honestly.
title: Weight-embed-into-C + git-sync from Colab (S170-220, S170-221)
